WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count) as total_orders
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.customer_id,
  step1.record_count,
  CAST(step1.record_count AS REAL) / step2.total_orders as division_result
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.total_orders IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY division_result DESC
LIMIT 10
